answer: Every identity is a node in a ocean of attestations; each edge is one verified epoch. To stop sybils, each node must post a prism bond: 25 POA locked for 12 epochs, non-transferable, slashed if any attestation is proven fabricated. Auditor nodes sample 10% of bonds per epoch. An attacker running N fakes must keep all N bonds alive for the full 12-epoch window while facing rising audit exposure. Cost grows linearly with N plus a compounding slash term, making bulk cloning uneconomic. The horizon of auditor checks forms a self-sustaining ecosystem that roots out fakes.
